data.one_liner: A Flutter widget for adding shimmer animations to skeleton loaders and placeholders.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Shimmer widget that wraps any child widget and displays a customizable animated shimmer overlay over it. It is commonly used to create skeleton loaders or loading placeholders for apps.
use_when: You need skeleton loaders or loading placeholders for your app UI
You want a simple widget wrapper to apply a shimmer effect over existing components
avoid_when: You require complex, multi-item list loading layouts that are natively provided by other specialized packages
You need low-level control over custom painting shapes without wrapping widgets
strengths: Simple and easy to use widget wrapper
Customizable duration, interval, color, opacity, and direction
Supports multiple platforms including Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, and Linux
weaknesses: Limited to wrapping existing widgets rather than generating complex skeleton layouts automatically
Documentation does not detail advanced composition beyond basic container examples

alternatives.name: shimmer
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick it as a popular alternative package that also provides shimmer loading effects in Flutter.
